    pn.panemark as panel_id,
    p.initdate as start_date,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(CURRENT_DATE, p.initdate))::numeric as service_years,

    (pr.efficiency_profile->'degradation'->>'cumdegpct')::numeric as efficiency_loss_metric,
    ROUND(CAST((pn.paneeffpct - (pr.efficiency_profile->'current_efficiency'->>'curreffpct')::numeric) / NULLIF(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(CURRENT_DATE, p.initdate)), 0) / NULLIF((pr.efficiency_profile->'degradation'->>'anndegrate')::numeric, 0) AS numeric), 4) as ndi,
    CASE 
        WHEN ROUND(CAST((pn.paneeffpct - (pr.efficiency_profile->'current_efficiency'->>'curreffpct')::numeric) / NULLIF(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(CURRENT_DATE, p.initdate)), 0) / NULLIF((pr.efficiency_profile->'degradation'->>'anndegrate')::numeric, 0) AS numeric), 4) > 1.5 THEN 'High Degradation'
